subject: Re: JAX-MPC kickoff — a standard control stack for sim benchmarks
body: Status ahead of the adopt/park decision. Interface: hardened — the MPPI class now runs unmodified against all three internal sim envs behind the step/reward protocol, with scan=True as default (Ondrej measured 2.1× wall-clock improvement over the unscanned loop at the reference 5×16×16 config). Baselines: MPPI beats our existing hand-tuned planners on two of three envs; the third (contact-heavy) needs longer horizons than the 16-step config plus reward tuning we haven't done. Scaling study: vmap scales near-linearly to 2048 samples on a single titan A100 slice, then host-transfer overheads bite; Quentin's writeup lands Friday. Risk for the decision: the contact-heavy result could be read as a method limit — Gustavo argues it's a horizon/reward-shaping issue, and a 64-step run this week should settle it before Ulla's end-of-June review. — Wanjiru
